newsitem.title: FRANCE: Paris full-frighter flights up 21 pct in first 4 months.
newsitem.headline: Paris full-frighter flights up 21 pct in first 4 months.

text.p: Full-freighter flights at the Paris airports in the first four months of 1997 totalled 7,199, an increase of 21 percent on the same period the previous year, Paris airport authority (ADP) figures show.

Freighter flights operating at CDG totalled 6,574, an increase of 23.9 percent on January-April 1996. However, freighter flights from Orly fell by three percent to 625, reflecting the gradual switch of such services to CDG, an ADP source said.
ADP January-April 1997 total air cargo throughput amounted to 365,702 tonnes with the full freighters share at 40.8 percent of the overall figure, compared to 39.8 percent in January-April 1996.
In tonnage terms, full freighters moved 149,049 tonnes in the first four months of 1997, a rise of of 4.9 percent on 1996 levels.

Full-freighter flights accounted for 3.6 percent of all flights operating at the Paris airports in January-April 1997 compared to 3.1 percent in the same 1996 period. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
